title: Local-base-change cohomology and canonical germ comparison
statement: Let f:X→Y be a scheme morphism, y∈Y, F an O_X-module and p≥0 [def-pc-fibre-product, def-pc-module-pullback, pqf-def-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Put A=O_(Y,y), X′=Spec(A)×_Y X, g′:X′→X and f′:X′→Spec(A). Define H=H^p(X′,g′*F) with A-action through Gamma-Spec and f′.appTop. For an A-linear map a:(R^p f_*F)_y→H, define IsFormalFunctionsLocalComparison by the following formula for every resolution I of F, resolution K of g′*F, neighbourhood V of y, open comparison choices D [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices] and class xi on f^{-1}V. Restriction to W=g′^{-1}(f^{-1}V) of a applied to the germ of the resolutionSectionClass of xi is moduleCohomologyFMap of the restricted g′-map D.psi applied to xi [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap]. All class maps and restriction units are the canonical ones in the Lean formula.

def IsFormalFunctionsLocalComparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y)
    (F : X.Modules) (p : ℕ)
